# Sprint Retrospectives

This folder is **generated on demand** — it is empty in a fresh Hyperion clone.

## When files appear here

| Trigger | Skill | Output pattern |
|---------|-------|----------------|
| "Vamos fazer a retro" / "Run sprint retro" | `sprint-retro` | `retro-{sprint}-{date}.md` |

The skill creates this folder automatically if it does not exist.

## What to expect

Each retro document captures sprint outcomes: what went well, what to improve, and concrete action items.
